definitions.balanced_relative_mse: Within each season, half full-pool MSE/rolling20 MSE plus half likely-pool MSE/rolling20 MSE; average seasons equally.
definitions.current_total: Locked supported-score blend plus 2 times lag-only defensive-hit prior; historical assist/bonus definitions remain approximate.
definitions.historical_likely_pool: Prior-six mean minutes >=45 and positive prior history at the shared origin.
definitions.portable: Earlier trained learned-subtotal procedure, refitted on each earlier fold; not the original GitHub advisor.
definitions.six_week_decision_interval: Candidate minus reference supported points per complete frozen six-GW squad plan, equal season weight.
definitions.supported_score: Known scoring subtotal + 3 times historical FPL assists + historical bonus; defensive awards excluded.

historical_practical_gates_vs_rolling.meaning: Point-estimate historical practical gates only. This does not pass decision/current-rule/portability/promotion gates.

historical_practical_gates_vs_strongest.meaning: Point-estimate historical practical gates only. This does not pass decision/current-rule/portability/promotion gates.

limitations: The final exported blend is different from the portable procedure selected throughout the four historical outer seasons.
Exact original-advisor comparison is restricted to seven already-exposed current-season snapshots.
Archive rows are observed opportunities; historical eligible rosters and publication deadlines are not certified.
Reconstructed historical origins and realised fixture calendars are assumptions, and incomplete future outcomes are excluded.
Current totals use historical assist/bonus definitions and an unvalidated lag-only defensive prior.
Block intervals are descriptive and conditional on this finite search, not selection-adjusted or prospective.
Fixed synthetic/owned squads do not establish gains from transfers, chips, or season-long rank policy.
Python-level relocation isolation is not an operating-system sandbox or native-I/O guarantee.

portable.scope: Descriptive paired within-season calendar-GW block bootstrap, equal season weight; conditional on the preceding search and reconstructed population. Not selection-adjusted, prospective, or independent player trials.
